translations.translatedText: # Monday 30.1.2023 (radio)
Memory disorders. Work. Temporary protection. Household deduction. Weather.
## Brain washing
![Computer screen showing different parts of the brain.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6052,h_3404,x_0,y_536/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-106479263d3982585dd1/1674811713)
Open image viewer

A group at the University of Oulu has succeeded in filming the pulsation of the brain with an ultra-fast magnetic resonance imaging method. Here are brain images at Oulu University Hospital. Photo: Elisa Kinnunen / Yle
A new breakthrough is being sought in the treatment of memory diseases.

A brain imaging technique has been developed at the University of Oulu. Ultra-fast magnetic resonance imaging shows changes in a patient who suffers, for example, from Alzheimer's disease more precisely than before.
Sleep cleans the brain, but the brain does not always clean itself naturally. In Oulu, final funding is now being sought for a machine that helps with brain washing.

The brain may have a blood-brain barrier, because of which medication cannot get into the brain effectively. With an ultrasound machine the blood-brain barrier can be opened briefly. Then up to 100 times the amount of medicine can get into the brain.
Almost 15,000 Finns alone receive an Alzheimer's diagnosis every year.
## Amount of work
![Building work on an apartment block.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3587,h_2018,x_0,y_376/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6689505ea80c6d06f00/1588072177)
Open image viewer
The amount of work has grown slightly. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
In Finland 4.1 billion hours of work were done last year. Statistics Finland says that the figure rose by 0.9 percent from the year before.
In social and health services working hours fell slightly. The social and health sector is Finland's largest industry.
The employment rate of 15–64-year-olds was 73.8 percent last year. The employment rate grew by 1.6 percentage points from the year before.
The employment rate shows how large a share of 15–64-year-olds do at least one hour of paid work a week.
## Temporary protection
![Finnish Immigration Service in Helsinki, 3.2.2021.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5568,h_3132,x_0,y_296/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-769765601aa93c154d6/1643195926)
Open image viewer
A record number of temporary protection applications have been made in Finland. Photo: Jorge Gonzalez / Yle
A record number of people applied for protection in Finland last year, says the Finnish Immigration Service, Migri. The number grew after Russia attacked Ukraine last February.
Usually people move to Finland most for work, family and studies. Now the largest group was Ukrainians.
Last year over 47,000 applications for temporary protection were lodged in Finland. Over 45,000 applicants got permission. Temporary protection is granted to a limited target group.
The number of residence permits based on work also grew last year.
## Household deduction
![Window cleaning.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11433984)
Open image viewer

For example, a cleaning company can now make a household deduction for the customer to the Tax Administration on the customer's behalf, if this is first agreed with the customer. Photo: Tiina Jutila / Yle

A household deduction no longer needs to be applied for oneself, if one does not want to or cannot. Now a company can also report the household deduction to the Tax Administration on the customer's behalf.
A household deduction means relief on taxes.
Until now, for example, the household deduction for cleaning has had to be applied for oneself. The change is a relief, for example, for elderly people.
The Tax Administration reminds that the customer and the company must agree together on the change in the reporting practice.
## The weather
![Weather map of Finland.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12688426)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
Tuesday's weather is fair in the south and west, and in places the sun shines. In the east and north it is cloudy and snow falls lightly.
Frost is 1 to 10 degrees. In the south there are a few degrees above zero.
